Records while the screen is off or the app is minimised, with a persistent notification. Keep location enabled. Battery controls and device GPS availability can interrupt recording. Distance is an estimate; this is not a safety tracker.
Only duration and estimated distance are stored privately on this device. Coordinates are used in memory and discarded. Nothing is uploaded.
Recording was interrupted. The last checkpoint is paused; resume explicitly. Time and distance since that checkpoint may be missing.
Allow notifications when asked to see recording controls outside the app. If notifications are disabled, reopen My walks to pause or finish.
Waiting for a recent location accurate to 40 m or better. Time continues; distance may be incomplete.
%1$s · %2$s active time
Journal duration is rounded up to at least one whole minute. Zero distance means no reliable movement was measured; you can correct it later.
